required_inputs: Official primary URL; exact issuing-body identity
pass_condition: Identity is verified on an official primary website
notes: Negative test: missing source remains LOCKED.

pass_condition: Issuing authority and scope are verified
notes: An organization root is not automatically a regulation.

required_inputs: Exact version or edition; publication date; effective date
pass_condition: All version fields are verified from the official issuer
notes: Negative test: version unknown remains LOCKED.

pass_condition: Supersession has been checked and current status is explicit
notes: Negative test: supersession unchecked remains LOCKED; historical records are retained.

gate_name: Exact article clause or page linkage
required_inputs: Claim ID; versioned source ID; exact article, clause, or page
notes: Negative test: absent clause or page remains LOCKED or REVIEW_REQUIRED; this stage has no qualifying links.

required_inputs: Canonical text; translation; source version; bilingual review
pass_condition: Qualified bilingual reviewer confirms legal and Judo meaning
notes: Negative test: unreviewed translation is not eligible for rule wording.

required_inputs: Jurisdiction; age category; event level; effective dates
pass_condition: Applicability scope is explicit and reviewed
notes: Do not transfer international, continental, national, adapted, veteran, cadet, or event-specific rules across scopes.

required_inputs: Document kind; authority class; claim-use boundary
pass_condition: Guidance, administration, regulation, and science are separated
notes: Negative test: official-organization content is not automatically regulation.

required_inputs: Exact claim; explicit source; evidence class; limitations
pass_condition: Suitable evidence and claim-level traceability are reviewed
notes: Negative test: a safety claim without suitable evidence remains LOCKED.

required_inputs: Medical consequence; population; evidence; medical sign-off
pass_condition: Appropriate qualified medical reviewer signs the bounded use
notes: Negative test: injury, diagnosis, return-to-play, or medical consequence without medical sign-off remains LOCKED.

pass_condition: Every required domain role has completed a bounded review
notes: Negative test: one human role alone creates no cross-domain scientific approval.

required_inputs: Approved source mapping; limitations; localization; product copy
pass_condition: Wording is accurate, scoped, localized, and non-medical unless approved
notes: Coaching precautions must not become diagnosis, causation, or individualized prescription.

required_inputs: Prior record; replacement identity; dates; provenance
pass_condition: Historical record and explicit supersession chain are retained
notes: Never overwrite a historical classification or erase a superseded record silently.

required_inputs: All applicable gates; approvals; rule eligibility; production authorization
pass_condition: Every required gate passes through separately authorized human review
notes: Negative tests: engineering validation PASS creates no scientific approval; no gate in JM-S0.4-A enables production.
